arms.control: Pinned neutral project with no WCBS package, instruction files, hooks, or global WCBS state.
arms.treatment: The same project and runtime profile with one WCBS V2 native plugin installation.

randomization.protocol: Randomize case and arm presentation order with a recorded seed before execution. Keep arm labels out of judge materials.
randomization.seed_source: Recorded cryptographic seed in the immutable run manifest.

judging.protocol: An independent blinded judge scores each locked criterion from redacted transcripts and produced artifacts. No self-scoring and no arm label disclosure.

execution_identity.state: Blocked until the exact runtime version and immutable model identity are committed before the first paid run.

redaction_rules: Use a dedicated evaluation credential and never persist it.
Remove user, project, and credential secrets before judge review.
Store transcript hashes and immutable run metadata before scoring.
release_rule: No parity or superiority claim may cite this design until all planned runs, blinded scoring, and independent evidence review are complete.
